name: dsh-insights
description: Index / validate / evaluate / analyze the whole DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin ecosystem. Zero-dependency Node pipeline: discover → manifest validation → metadata eval → snapshot dataset + report + static site.

scripts.snapshot: npm run analyze && npm run site && npm run export && npm run score && npm run export:json && npm run badges && npm run history && npm run overlap
scripts.finalize: npm run analyze && npm run site && npm run export && node bin/query.mjs --sort stars --top 8
scripts.refresh: npm run lists && npm run downloads && npm run analyze && npm run site && npm run export && npm run diff && npm run pages
